instruction: Find the slide that lists the principles of writing effective prompts and extract its content to a document named "principles.docx" on Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

phrases: One Prompt, One Idea, One Conversation

required_phrases: One Prompt, One Idea, One Conversation

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the 'Principles' slide (slide 20) and extracting its content to docx. Evaluator checks if all 6 principle phrases are present in the output document. Verified by analyzing PPTX: slide 20 contains all the principles listed.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction by checking for all 6 required principle phrases in the output DOCX file
Getter properly extracts text from the DOCX file using python-docx and checks phrase presence with case-insensitive matching

Complete coverage: verifies both that the correct slide was identified AND its content was extracted to the document
